name: dotloop
positioning: The transaction workspace where agent, client, broker and cooperating side edit and sign the same set of documents.
description: dotloop organises a deal as a "loop" — one shared workspace holding the contract set, the people, the tasks and the audit trail. Forms are filled with reusable data, signed electronically inside the product, and reviewed by a broker against a compliance checklist before the file is archived.
real_estate_use: From accepted offer to closing, everything a state or association form requires lives in the loop. The agent edits a purchase agreement without leaving the browser, the buyer signs on a phone, and the broker's compliance reviewer sees at a glance which documents are missing before commission is released. Its value shows up in audit season.
features: Loops holding documents, participants, tasks and messages per transaction
Built-in form editing with association and state form libraries
Legally binding e-signature with full audit trail
Broker compliance review queues and document checklists
Templates per transaction type and per office
Activity log and archived record retention

use_cases.job: Get a full contract package prepared, signed and stored without printing anything
Review every file against a compliance checklist before releasing commission
